title: Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Card Catch-Up Charges on Storage Unit Agreements: Terms and Tenant Approval Tool
content:
A tenant whose storage unit AutoPay draft on a card under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization was declined for insufficient funds or an expired card, on an authorization in active status, may approve on a recorded call a one-time catch-up charge to the same card for that due date, whether or not its retries are used. The approval is recorded on the authorization's notice history as a varying-amount notice for the declined due date stating the card catch-up charge, and the charge is submitted on the day after the handling date, so it covers the charges that will have posted by that charge day.

**In short.**

- *Applies to:* a storage unit agreement drafted by card, on an authorization in active status.
- *Decline reasons covered:* insufficient funds; expired card.
- *Retries:* the catch-up may be approved whether or not the due date's retries are used.
- *Who approves:* the tenant, on a recorded call.
- *Record:* a varying-amount notice on the authorization's notice history, for the declined due date, stating the card catch-up charge.
- *Charge day:* the day after the handling date.

## Tool: `approve_card_catchup_charge_edda4662`

**What it does.** The tenant, in person, approves a one-time catch-up charge to the card on file of a card AutoPay authorization, for a rent due date whose card draft was declined for insufficient funds or an expired card, whether or not its retries are used. One call records, on that authorization's notice history, a new varying-amount notice dated today carrying the due date the charge concerns and the exact dollar amount the tenant approves to be charged to the card. Nothing else on the authorization or on the rental agreement changes.

**Invocation.** The tool belongs to the tenant: the agent unlocks `approve_card_catchup_charge_edda4662` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Name | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `autopay_id` | The AutoPay authorization number of the card authorization to be charged, as shown in the AutoPay authorization lookup | Identifier |
| `notice_type` | The kind of notice record written | One of the values listed below |
| `related_due_date` | The rent due date whose declined card draft the charge concerns | YYYY-MM-DD, a calendar date with no time and no time zone |
| `approved_amount` | The charge the tenant approves | US dollars, positive, exactly 2 decimal places (for example 123.45); stored rounded half-to-even to the cent |

- `varying_amount_notice` — the record states an amount to be drafted or charged for one due date; this is the kind this action records.
- `card_expiry_reminder` — a reminder that the card on file is about to expire, carrying no amount.
- `draft_failure_notice` — word that a draft for a due date failed, carrying no amount.
- `suspension_notice` — word that the authorization has been suspended, carrying no amount.

**Return.** A text receipt of the form "Card catch-up charge <reference> approved on AutoPay <authorization number>: <amount> USD for due date <due date>, approved <date>.", the reference being the new notice reference beginning with apn_, the amount the stored amount with 2 decimals and both dates written YYYY-MM-DD, the approval date being today. A receipt in this form means the approval is on record; the tenant receives the confirmation reference and can see the approved charge and due date on the notice history.
